rationale: The garage camera (CAM-I2, wired) is offline even when placed directly next to the base station, ruling out weak signal. After a reset it logged a power-on event but no heartbeat followed, and the LED now shows no light at all despite being plugged in. Firmware is compatible (v3 protocol supported) and no error codes are present, so the failure is consistent with a hardware fault on the camera itself.

output.symptom_summary: Garage camera (CAM-I2, wired) has been offline for two days. Customer initially suspected weak signal, but camera remains offline even when placed next to base station.
output.suspected_root_cause: Hardware fault on the camera itself, as it shows no LED and no heartbeat after power-on event despite being powered and near base station.

results.text: CAM-S1 runs on a rechargeable battery lasting 3 to 6 months. Below 10 percent the camera disables live view and may miss events; below 3 percent it goes offline. Charge with the supplied USB-C cable for about 6 hours. Frequent motion events in busy areas shorten battery life; enable power-saving mode.

usability_reason: Clear, polite, and actionable (engineer will contact for replacement). It avoids overclaiming: the hardware-fault conclusion is grounded in the reported no-LED/no-heartbeat behavior near the base station. Minor deduction because the customer's power-type uncertainty was never resolved with them, yet the response asserts 'wired' and cites RSSI/log details not established in the session record.
